product.description: The LumaLite Portable LED Ring Light 10" is a compact illumination solution for photographers and content creators. Designed for handheld use, the ring light features a 10‑inch diameter LED array that delivers even, diffused light. It connects via USB‑C, drawing power from a standard charger or a portable battery pack. The unit is lightweight, weighing under a kilogram, and its matte black finish resists fingerprints. The light can be adjusted in intensity through a simple dial, and the included mounting ring accommodates standard camera lenses or smartphone holders. It is ideal for portrait shoots, product photography, and live streaming setups.
